exploit_name: Stale oracle gate blocks all dispatchFrom operations including liquidations
description: Oracle staleness check executes before determining operation type, blocking all operations when spot-TWAP divergence exceeds 513 ticks (~5.27%). Exploitable via front-running swaps.
attack_scenario: Liquidation detected. Attacker front-runs swap pushing currentTick beyond threshold. Liquidation reverts. Attacker back-runs to restore price. Repeats indefinitely.
root_cause: Oracle staleness check executes before determining operation type, blocking all operations when spot-TWAP divergence exceeds 513 ticks (~5.27%). Exploitable via front-running swaps.
fix_description: Implement degraded mode using TWAP/median ticks when out-of-range, or add two-step liquidation allowing execution after a delay.
notes: Liquidation DoS and griefing — insolvent positions remain open during stressed markets.
